note: Every row above base. Each hash is the path's git tree or blob hash at the reviewed commit. A commit whose hash differs runs that row at base and the run ends NEEDS_REVIEW. A change to this table is part of a story's commit, and its C1 and C2 review it.

R2b.what: The Rust lanes: profiles, classes, byte evidence, helper.

N1b.what: The native lane: profile, needs rows, gates.

own-agent-evidence.why: R2b: the sshd escape rests on these bytes: the real sshd, its private config lines, and no board, event, window or keychain route.

no-nsapplication.why: R2b, C2b-F1: 0 of 13 pasteboard programs hold NSApplication, the route that lets AppKit reach the general board on its own.

no-event-post.why: R2b: the window route is safe because of the payload's bytes: no CGEventPost, no flag state read.

no-owner-tty.why: R2b: the PTY line opens only what a test made itself: no path to a terminal by name, no TIOCSTI.

key-route.why: R2b: the SecurityServer line stands for one route, a test key by SecKeyCreateRandomKey. The screen forbids the other Security families.

target-tmp.why: R2b: the target/tmp line stands for this build path, baked in by the crate at build time.
